channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian strike kills two, wounds 60, in Zelenskyy’s hometown
item.description: Attack on Kryvyi Rih comes as Russian missiles land in NATO member Poland and US-led peace efforts face uncertainty.

item.title: Tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz as Iran tightens grip on shipping
item.description: British maritime agency reports two incidents near Oman, while Iran says a tanker caught fire due to naval mine.

item.title: Could Iran reverse its stated policy of a civil-only nuclear programme?
item.description: Iran's FM Araghchi says there is 'major strategic debate' about the future of Iran's nuclear doctrine.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Gaza faces deadly strikes and health crisis
item.description: Jerusalem Daily: Gaza faces deadly strikes and health crisis

item.title: Israeli strike on vehicle distributing food aid in Gaza kills three
item.description: Separately, Palestinian man is shot dead by Israeli forces in Jabalia and three people injured in attack in Khan Younis.

item.title: Russian missiles hit Poland: What happened, and could NATO respond?
item.description: Warsaw accuses Moscow of intentional provocation, but bar for triggering NATO's collective defence clause remains high.

item.title: Deadly fire engulfs power station in southern Iraq
item.description: At least four people were killed and 30 injured after a fire tore through the Hartha power station complex.

item.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
item.description: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

item.title: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East
item.description: The Pentagon has released an eighth tranche of UFO records, which includes three video clips recorded in 2020, 2023 and 2026.

item.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': Life inside Yemeni city besieged by Houthis
item.description: Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in the key city of Taiz, cut off from the outside world for weeks.
